title: You Can't See the Great Wall From Space
description: Despite the famous myth, the Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked eye from the Moon, and is very hard to see from orbit.

scenes.text: You may have heard that the Great Wall of China is the only human-made thing you can see from space. It is a myth.
scenes.subject: wall
scenes.say: You may have heard that the Great Wall of China is the only human-made thing you can see from space. [chuckles] It is a myth.

scenes.text: The wall is very long, but mostly only a few meters wide, and its color blends in with the land around it.
scenes.subject: wall
scenes.say: The wall is very long, but mostly only a few meters wide, and its color blends in with the land around it.

scenes.text: From the Moon, astronauts say you cannot see any single human-made structure at all.
scenes.subject: moon
scenes.say: [curious] From the Moon, astronauts say you cannot see any single human-made structure at all.

scenes.text: Even from low orbit, astronauts say the wall is very hard to spot with the naked eye. City lights at night are much easier.
scenes.say: Even from low orbit, astronauts say the wall is very hard to spot with the naked eye. City lights at night are much easier.

scenes.text: Long does not mean visible. Follow for more weird facts.
